integrity: The theorem is proved analytically with positive-domain endpoint checks. Portable exact-rational code is corroborative, not a substitute for proof. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only exact population even moments for uncapped lateral flat cylinders with positive circumference and height. No stability under sampling error, extension to arbitrary surfaces, or full historical-priority certification is established. One potentially relevant general primary paper was available only as an abstract.
title: Three even geodesic-distance moments reconstruct every flat circular cylinder
